# Studio

Vira > [Modules](../../README.md) > [Design](../README.md) > Studio

The hosted studio page and its save path into the design-foundation checkout.

`designstudio.py` mounts the checkout (default root
`~/workspace/design-foundation`) and exposes save, commit and push.

## What lives here

Everything below is generated from `module.json` and the files themselves. Scripts, assets, tests and documents that belong to this submodule are listed here even while they still sit in the shared top-level folders; see "Moving code" in the root README.
